description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the full lifecycle of consumer products, from identifying user needs and shaping product direction to building and shipping polished experiences. This hands-on role brings product strategy, design, and full-stack engineering together, with a focus on creating products users value and return to.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define product positioning, scope features, and identify the smallest complete versions to test and improve.

 - Design user experiences and interfaces that support adoption and retention.

 - Build and maintain frontend and backend systems using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.

 - Develop APIs, data models, authentication, and payment systems.

 - Set up analytics, run experiments, and monitor products in production.

 - Ship polished MVPs or substantial iterations quickly while maintaining quality.

 - Debug production issues, incorporate user feedback, and take ownership of engagement and retention outcomes.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2 to 10+ years of experience building and shipping consumer products end to end.

 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js, with experience in APIs, SQL databases, and data modeling.

 - Hands-on experience with authentication, payments, subscriptions, and deployment.

 - Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation tools, such as PostHog.

 - Comfort using AI development tools while maintaining sound architectural judgment and code quality.

 - Consumer product experience, particularly with social apps, communication tools, or cross-platform development, is beneficial.

 - A product-minded approach, strategic thinking about user problems, and ownership of outcomes.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California, United States.
